source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
Whenever this unit is the target of an attack, if its models have different **T** characteristics, **wound rolls** for that attack use the **T** most of its models have, until the attacking models finish their attacks. A tie for most uses the highest tied **T**.

For embarking within a **TRANSPORT**, each Gravis Veteran model counts as 2 models for space. It can still embark within any **TRANSPORT** its unit can, even though comparable models in other units carry the **GRAVIS** keyword.

combat.unresolved: Withheld as a class: the last two independent reviews found 7 of 300 sampled combat readings of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, not under the 2% this reading may ship with.

woundToughness.use: T of the majority of models
woundToughness.until: the attacking models have finished making their attacks

transport.mayEmbarkIn: any TRANSPORT this unit can embark within
transport.despite: similar models in other units have GRAVIS
